title: 초등학교 미디어교육을 위한 블렌디드 프로젝트 학습 프로그램 개발

abstracts.value:
본 연구의 목적은 그동안 초등학교 미디어교육 활동에 제약이 되어왔던 시공간적 한계를 극복하고, 체계적인 미디어교육의 운영을 위해 블렌디드 프로젝트 학습 프로그램의 초안을 개발하고, 실제적인 적용 수업을 통해 프로그램의 강점과 개선점을 추출하고자 하였다.
이에 따라 7차 교육과정의 창의적 재량활동을 중심으로 초등학생들이 미디어환경의 주체로서 비판적 수용력과 능동적인 참여, 창조적인 생산자로서의 능력을 개발할 수 있도록 미디어교육의 특성과 교육내용, 블렌디드 학습전략 등을 고려하여 사전학습 프로젝트학습-사후학습 모듈로 이어지는 미디어 학습과정을 개발하였다. 또한 학습자의 학습경험을 극대화하고, 미디어교육의 효과와 효율성 증진을 위해 프로젝트를 중심으로 온·오프라인의 혼합학습 공간을 마련하였으며 학습내용에 따라 다양한 학습방법이 적용될 수 있도록 하였다.
프로그램 형성평가 결과, 온라인, 오프라인의 학습공간 활용 및 비평, 분석, 토의, 제작, 성찰의 다양한 학습방법에 대한 긍정적인 반응을 보였으며, 반면에 교사에 대한 부담을 줄여주기 위해 다양한 학습자원, 이를테면, 프로그램 활용에 대한 교사용 지침서 컴퓨터 활용 워커숍 등이 사전에 제공될 필요가 있으며, 동료간의 상호작용을 높일 수 있는 대화방과 같은 매체의 지원이 추가되어야 할 것으로 나타났다.
혼합학습환경을 기반으로 미디어 이론과 실제적인 제작을 통해 미디어의 주요 개념들 간의 연관성을 탐구할 수 있도록 설계된 본 프로그램은 교수자와 학습자간의 활발한 커뮤니케이션이 진행되는 가운데 디지털 미디어환경을 고려한 체계적인 미디어교육 실천 방안으로 기대되며 추출된 개선점의 제안을 통해 향후 미디어교육 프로그램의 개발에 도움을 줄 수 있을 것이다.

The purpose of this research was to develop the draft of practical media education program appropriate for Korean educational condition and media environment and reveal the effectiveness of it by introducing the blended study which recently attracted in many fields into media education.
The study process of this research that is focused on a creative discretion activity of the Seventh Education Program is made up three modules of prior study-project study-after study considering the characteristic and teaching contents of media education and blended study strategy. It is maximized learner's study experience and planed as a blended project study system that combines the study space, study form and diverse study methods focusing on the project to promote the effectiveness and efficiency of media education. Learners can get the whole understanding of program and learn the main concept of media through the prior study module of on-off line and after that they are planed to research the relationship of main concepts that studied in the prior study course through the practical producing experience of the project study module. They are planed to check and evaluate the process and result of their study for themselves through total reflection and evaluation in after study. These series of study process can make the study for media link continuously and circularly centering on a new project in the course of long-term curriculum and can make learners accomplish the critical understanding for media, active use for media and the aim of active production.
The draft of program developed in this research can get as following positive results with practically applying period for two months. First, learners were able to systematically learn the knowledge, technique and manner needed for media education while going through the steps of prior study, project study, after study according to blended study strategy. Second. the study space enlarged to on-off line helped to get over the limitation of time and space in conducting media education. Third, learners could accomplish effectively the role as a main body of media environment and a creative producer with critical acceptance, active participation through active use of media and the chance of diverse study experiences. Therefore this program is expected to be a practical device for systematic media education considering the digital media environment while teachers and learners are doing active communication in the education scene.
But, because of increasing the burden which is followed by blended study strategy connecting on and off-line and teacher's perfect preparation, and a management for learners to operate this program, the research for practical use of EPSS is needed to help teacher's burden and learner's smooth study accomplishment in the next following research, and the research for network system constitution and the database system construction for study content and study material constitution will have to be followed. Besides grounding on the basic frame for blended project study presented in this research, the research for blended study strategy and study methods of individual media such as internet, newspaper, TV, advertisement is needed to proceed in the concrete.
